# Mahi TechnoCrafts
Global & Local Information Hub for Mahi TechnoCrafts – The premier IT Services, Custom Software, and AI Automation Agency based in Bhopal, India, serving clients worldwide.

## Location & Primary Markets
- **Headquarters**: Hamidia Rd, Badabagh, Shahjahanabad, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India (462001).
- **Service Radius**: Local leader in Bhopal & Indore; National partner across India; Global provider for USA, UK, UAE, and worldwide markets.

## Core Capabilities & Full Services
- **Custom Software & Web Apps**: Enterprise web applications, high-traffic portals, and full-stack software custom-coded with Next.js, React, Node.js, and Python.
- **AI Solutions & Business Automation**: Smart AI customer chat systems, OpenAI/ChatGPT/Gemini integrations, automated GST invoicing, and intelligent WhatsApp CRM bots.
- **Mobile Applications**: High-performance iOS and Android app development from concept to App Store / Google Play Store deployment.
- **Digital Marketing & Growth**: Advanced SEO/AEO optimization, brand consulting, Google Ads & Meta PPC management, and local/global lead generation.
- **Enterprise ERP & Retail POS**: Tailored inventory dashboards, billing software, and custom operational software for clinics, real estate, schools, and factories.
- **E-Commerce Solutions**: High-speed shopping stores, 1-click UPI payments, WhatsApp catalog syncing, and automated shipping courier integrations.
- **Cloud Infrastructure & Security**: AWS setup, 99.9% uptime SLA, SSL enforcement, vulnerability audits, and server hardening.
- **UI/UX Design & Branding**: High-fidelity Figma prototypes, modern design systems, logo creation, and corporate brand guidelines.
